_description: ORCA-Denominator on TREC Clinical Trials 2021/2022. Mirrors config/orca_denominator_config.json field-for-field except where the domain genuinely differs, so an ER-DEN result on this dataset is read against the career ER-DEN result without confounds. Wired by trials_domain/run_config.py, which injects the MeSH matcher and the grade-aware negative selector.
_comment_cache: A dedicated cache path. The shared default (embedding_cache/text_embeddings.pt) is keyed by content hash, so a shared file would mix career and trials vectors; isolation here is by explicit path, not convention.
_comment_augmentation: No view augmentation. The career augmenter rewrites role/experience/title text with career-specific transformation rules; applied to a patient narrative or an eligibility criteria block it would produce clinically meaningless text. Both slots already carry a pre-serialized encoder_view.
_comment_negatives: Negatives come from the injected TrialsNegativeSelector, which draws each topic's own graded qrels (grade 1 = ineligible/hard, grade 0 = not relevant/easy). Pathway negatives are off: CareerGraph is an ESCO occupation graph with no clinical analogue. Global pooling is off because pooling across topics would defeat the per-topic graded pool.
_comment_curriculum: The grade-1 share ramps 0.2 -> 0.6 across training, mirroring the career linear_easy_to_hard schedule. Unlike the career tiers (terciles of a computed distance) these tiers are the human judgments themselves.
_comment_ontology: MeSH replaces ESCO/ISCO. The esco_* paths are deliberately null: trials_domain/run_config.py injects a MeshMatcher through BatchProcessor.set_ontology_matcher, so no ESCO artifact is loaded. ontology_guided_negatives is true so the ontology scoring path is active even though ontology_weight is modest.
_comment_orca_ot: orca_capture_ot_distance stays false: d_ot is a Sinkhorn solve per (topic, negative) pair, and on MeSH the tree-distance cost matrix adds nothing the set similarity does not already carry at this scale.
